lines.text: Pip the tiny brown mouse made a solemn promise to his best friend Barney Bear!
I will bring you the magical blue seed before the forest sun sets!
On his way back, Pip stumbled upon a sparkling river of sweet strawberries!
All the squirrels cheered, Stay and feast with us, Pip! Sunset is far away!
Pip's tummy rumbled, but he remembered Barney waiting patiently by the mossy rock!
Pip said, Sweet berries are delicious, but my word is like solid gold!
He scurried across the bridge and arrived just as the first evening star twinkled!
Barney gave Pip a giant bear hug—trust is the greatest treasure in the world!
Be a friend who keeps their word—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
